output.patientMessage: I recommend a standard (same-day service-hours target) message review by a Counsel clinician in this thread for your birth control refill. Refills usually need a brief check of your history — things like headaches with visual or neurological symptoms, smoking and any blood-clot history — before a prescription is issued. If you develop sudden weakness, trouble speaking, or facial droop, call 911. New chest pain, severe leg swelling or pain, or new severe headache needs same-day clinician assessment.
